source_inventory.semantic_mapping_limit: Role labels are source-format mappings. Static samples were viewed; engine semantics and timing were not validated.

visual_evidence.contact_sampling: one representative static view per group
visual_evidence.style_reference_role: rendering only; fine modeled volume, subtle texture and concentrated highlights

observed_native_identity: Unarmored, unclothed adult human skeleton; exposed ribs, pelvis, bony hands and feet.
Right-facing skull with dark empty sockets and no glowing eyes.
Narrow forward-leaning torso, sword arm bent backward, empty arm forward, bent-knee spread stance.
One straight pointed sword held low at the back hip, blade descending diagonally toward screen right.
Muted ivory/yellow-gray bone with olive-gray recesses; pale steel blade, warm brass/gold hilt, tiny blue-violet grip accent.
No shield, helmet, armor, clothes, extra weapon or magical effects in the inspected samples.

registration.method: provided registerMaster helper; uniform aspect-preserving height scale and native silhouette center/bottom

review_findings.identity: Basic Skeleton identity and single sword retained; no upgrade armor or shield introduced.
review_findings.pose_and_facing: Right-facing forward lean, rear sword hand, forward empty hand and bent-knee spread stance visibly retained.
review_findings.materials: Fine modeled, lightly worn bone; restrained metal highlights. Bone highlights are slightly creamier than source.
review_findings.small_scale: At 192 px visible height, skull facing, open ribs, empty hand, feet and down-right sword remain readable.
review_findings.alpha: Inspected on light and dark review backgrounds; no obvious floor, cast shadow, labels or clipped props. Review backgrounds are not baked into usable assets.
remaining_risks: Generated silhouette is 4 px narrower than native-derived target at the common scale.
Skull, joint forms, rib spacing and hand articulation interpret details that native pixels do not fully resolve; perfect anatomical accuracy is not claimed.
Sword guard is more regularized and bone highlights somewhat creamier than the native source.
This master has no evidence of animation continuity, timings, transitions or action alignment.
Coexistence with actual game backgrounds, technical import and runtime appearance remain unverified.

scope_and_limits.next_gate: human approval of static master before animation generation
